title: iPhone 18 Production Delay Could Put Apple's Spring Launch Under Pressure
summary: iPhone 18 Production Delay Could Put Apple's Spring Launch Under Pressure
detailed: Apple's mass manufacturing for the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e has reportedly been pushed back to around January 1, 2027.
The supply chain rumor, shared by leaker Fixed Focus Digital on Weibo, indicates production resources were initially prioritized for high-end devices like the iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Duo.
Despite the delayed production start, the devices are still rumored for a spring launch in February or March 2027 and are expected to feature Apple's A20 chipset and 9 GB of RAM.
This matters because a shorter manufacturing window prior to the target release date places operational pressure on Apple's supply chain and inventory preparation.
sentences: Apple may have less time than expected to prepare its next standard iPhone models for launch.
A fresh supply chain rumour suggests that production of the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e has been pushed back again, with mass manufacturing now expected to begin around January 1, 2027.
The claim comes from the Chinese leaker known as Fixed Focus Digital, who shared the latest information on Weibo.
According to the post, neither phone has entered mass production yet.
That is a notable change from earlier expectations, which placed the production start in October or, more recently, late November.
If the January timeline holds, Apple will have a relatively short window to build inventory before the phones are expected to arrive in February or March 2027.
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has previously pointed to that launch period for the two models.
Apple's supply chain priorities may explain some of the pressure.
The company has already introduced the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max alongside its foldable iPhone Duo in September.
Production resources have reportedly been focused on those higher-end devices, leaving the standard models for the next release window.

The iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e are also expected to share more hardware than previous models.
Fixed Focus Digital has claimed that both could use similar manufacturing processes and components, including batteries and 6.3-inch displays.
However, other reports disagree about the display size of the more affordable iPhone 18e.
Both of the devices are reported to come equipped with Apple’s A20 chipset.
Leaks also suggest that there would be 9 GB of RAM as against the 8 GB in the older model along with Apple’s C2 modem.
The new iPhone 18e has also been reported to sport an enhanced battery and front camera.
A postponed production does not necessarily imply a postponed release either.
Apple may still be able to launch the device on its planned schedule in the spring season.
